scope: Headless production C++20 terminal adapter; not PTY, persistent service, GUI, GPU or latency acceptance
dependency_reuse: Previously built and replayed pinned Ghostty ReleaseSafe archives; no dependency pin changes

linux.platform: Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64 in a local native container
commands: cmake configure with pinned Ghostty prefix

sanitizer_scope: ASan/UBSan instruments the C++ adapter and tests; upstream Zig library remains ReleaseSafe, not ASan-instrumented

resource_contract.snapshot: Owned contiguous cells and graphemes; capped cell/codepoint counts; one reused extraction scratch vector
resource_contract.replies: Preallocated bounded storage, no allocation or exceptions in callback; overflow permanently faults the instance
resource_contract.history: Eviction, viewport retention, clearing and budget restoration exercised; upstream page granularity is not a strict byte/RSS ceiling
resource_contract.image_storage: Disabled; file, temporary-file and shared-memory image media disabled

skipped.reason: No threading or ownership handoff introduced; single-owner contract

skipped.check: Engine comparison rebuild and full dependency rescan
skipped.reason: Unchanged pinned dependency graph; reused successful checkpoint builds and dated audit scope
No renderer or presentation endpoint implemented

limitations: Full keyboard/text/IME, mouse, selection, scrollback navigation and broader compatibility remain unqualified
A successful adjacent source receipt is provenance, not output binary integrity
Bundled simdutf modification provenance and a complete SBOM remain open before binary redistribution
No end-to-end responsiveness or process-memory guarantee is claimed
